purpose: Original study illustrations inspired by user-provided crayon-style references; no claim of handmade authorship

prompts.reading:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original illustration for a Thai Constitution study notebook for adults.
The attached pictures are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Create a completely new scene, not a copy of any depicted composition. Use the same approachable wax-crayon and colored-pencil-on-paper vocabulary: irregular hand-pressure, scratchy overlapping strokes, broken outlines, white paper showing through, slightly wonky proportions, simple expressive faces, charming handmade sketchbook character. No smooth digital fill, vector polish, glossy 3D, photorealism, lettering, captions, logos or watermarks.
Recurring subject: a young adult Thai woman with shoulder-length dark brown hair, warm tan skin, an amber sweater and charcoal trousers, studying in her own quiet time. Original fictional character, not a portrait of a real person.
Color: amber yellow/orange, charcoal and warm brown, small muted skin tones. White paper background merging into a white webpage; no colored rectangle or frame. Centered compact composition with plenty of white margin, square image, entire subject visible. Cute but adult, affectionate and unhurried. Scene: sitting at a small wooden table with an open book and a tablet, gently tracing a line in the book with her finger; a pencil and a mug nearby. The book contains only short abstract scribble lines, never invented legal text. One small scene, not a collage.
